pipeline.report_title: kickoff time / weekday incremental O/U 2.5 audit
pipeline.preregistration_markdown:
# Frozen kickoff/calendar O/U 2.5 protocol

Status: **PREREGISTERED / TEMPORAL OOS / RESEARCH ONLY**.

Leagues: EPL, La Liga, Serie A. No 2026/27.
Reference/train: through 2023/24; validation: 2024/25; untouched test: 2025/26.
Target: FTHG + FTAG > 2.5.
Baseline: league + devigged Bet365 O/U 2.5 probability.
Calendar extension: weekday, kickoff-hour sin/cos and frozen time-slot buckets.
Estimator: fixed regularized logistic regression.
Primary metric: log loss; Brier/AUC diagnostics.
Support requires lower calendar-model log loss in validation and OOT plus OOT paired bootstrap 95% CI for calendar-minus-baseline delta entirely below zero.
No production model, paid API, Supabase or automatic promotion.

recipes.description: Test frozen alignment_dot temporal stability across 2019/20-2025/26 without rescuing the failed replication gate.

pipeline.preregistration_markdown:
# Frozen cross-market lead-lag temporal stability V1

Status: **PREREGISTERED / OUTCOME-FREE / NO_BET / NO_RESCUE**.

Preserve the existing `alignment_dot` statistic exactly across EPL, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga and Ligue 1 for seasons 2019/20-2025/26.

Primary temporal-instability test: an omnibus within-league season-label permutation of between-season alignment variance at alpha 0.05.

Strict descriptive stability pattern (not a rescue gate): no significant temporal heterogeneity, positive pooled season mean in at least 6/7 seasons, and a stratified-bootstrap 95% CI above zero in at least 4/7 seasons.

The failed independent replication validation decision in Issue #482 remains binding under every outcome. Do not change the statistic, choose seasons after seeing results, use match outcomes, use 2026/27, paid APIs, Supabase or production.

recipes.description: Preregistered EPL/La Liga/Serie A heterogeneity audit of calendar-minus-market log-loss deltas after the negative pooled test.

pipeline.preregistration_markdown:
# Preregistered kickoff/calendar league heterogeneity V1

Status: **PREREGISTERED / TEMPORAL OOS / HETEROGENEITY ONLY / NO RESCUE**.

Fit the same market-baseline and calendar-extension logistic models separately within EPL, La Liga and Serie A using reference seasons 2019/20-2023/24; evaluate validation 2024/25 and untouched OOT 2025/26.

Primary heterogeneity rule: for each of the three league pairs, bootstrap the OOT difference in per-match calendar-minus-baseline log loss with Bonferroni familywise alpha 0.05. A pair supports heterogeneity only if its adjusted OOT interval excludes zero and validation/OOT differences have the same sign.

Any subgroup result is heterogeneity evidence only. It cannot rescue or overturn the negative pooled Issue #428 result. No arbitrary time cutoffs, weekday selection, league dropping, 2026/27, paid APIs, Supabase or production.
